svg.aria-label: PriceWatch. Serverless price tracker on AWS. EventBridge every 30 minutes triggers a Lambda scraper in Docker, prices go to DynamoDB, and SNS sends an email alert.
svg.title: PriceWatch. Serverless price tracker on AWS. EventBridge every 30 minutes triggers a Lambda scraper in Docker, prices go to DynamoDB, and SNS sends an email alert.
svg.text: Team of three. I owned the backend, API and frontend
Watches prices in six Mexican online stores
and emails you when one drops below your target.
Plus a REST API on Lambda and a dashboard hosted on S3.
